description:
Use this when the user asks how an Indian company listed on NSE or BSE has performed financially: revenue, profit, margins, balance sheet, cash flow or growth, quarterly or annual. Not for non-Indian companies; for a period-by-period growth series use get_financial_trends.

Returns the profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow for each period, with margins, the group's profit and the owners' share of it, a trailing-twelve-month block, and an annual growth summary (year-on-year and 3- and 5-year growth in revenue, net profit, EBITDA and EPS). `period_type` is "quarterly" (default), "annual" or "half_yearly" (what an SME files instead of quarters); `limit` is periods newest first (default 8, at most 20); `statement_type` is "auto" (default), "consolidated" or "standalone". Sub-annual results carry no cash flow: use `period_type="annual"` for it. Banks and NBFCs report interest income and net interest income, and insurers premium income, in place of revenue and EBITDA. Trust units return filed trust results: distribution per unit, NAV and cash flow. For growth and margins period by period, or segments over time, use get_financial_trends.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
